The slot has `capacity 8` and the host asserts nine codepoints, so the assert returns `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_BREACH` (-710) and names the capacity. PATH PINNED: libds `rete_validate_slot_kinds` in `wm_rete.c`, which every path into working memory reaches through `ds_rete_wm_assert_ex` and which runs before the no-op probe, the identity retract and the intern acquire; the Mercury runtime's `ds.engine.host_assert` through `ds.fact.lstr_11_3_over_capacity`, which refuses the candidate before `wm_max`. A runtime that truncated the value, or stored it and reported afterwards, raises nothing here and the vector goes red.
